stories.headline: Apple ships M6 with 40% faster neural engine and M5 Ultra for local AI workloads
stories.blurb: The M6 chip brings a neural engine 40% faster than M5, while the new M5 Ultra doubles down on on-device AI with unified memory up to 512GB. Both chips target developers running local LLMs, training models, and building AI apps without cloud dependencies.
stories.why_it_matters: Local AI just got a lot more practical for developers who want to prototype and deploy without API costs.
stories.original_headline: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra for a big leap in performance and AI compute

stories.headline: Claude can now remember what you said in chat when it writes code
stories.blurb: Anthropic just connected Claude's memory across chat and its Cowork coding feature. Tell Claude about your project once in conversation, and it'll remember those details when you switch to writing code — no more re-explaining your tech stack or preferences every session.
stories.why_it_matters: You can finally brief an AI agent once instead of resetting context every time you switch tasks.
stories.original_headline: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat

stories.headline: Keenable built a search index so AI agents can browse the web
stories.blurb: The startup raised $26 million to create a dedicated web index for AI agents — not humans. Instead of showing blue links, it structures web data so agents can actually navigate sites, fill forms, and complete tasks across the internet without breaking.
stories.why_it_matters: Agents need search engines built for code, not eyeballs — this is infrastructure for the agentic web.
stories.original_headline: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents

stories.headline: ChatGPT's task scheduler is now free for everyone
stories.blurb: OpenAI opened its task scheduling feature to free users, letting you set up recurring prompts like daily summaries or weekly reports. Paid users get trigger-based automation — ChatGPT can now watch your Gmail, Slack, or GitHub and run prompts when specific things happen.
stories.why_it_matters: ChatGPT just became a lightweight automation tool you don't need to pay for.
stories.original_headline: Free accounts can now access ChatGPT's upgraded task scheduling tool

try_this_prompt.title: The code smell interpreter
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'll paste a function or code snippet below. Don't refactor it. Instead, tell me: what design decision led to this shape, what problem it's secretly trying to solve that isn't in the comments, and what will break first when requirements change.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: For understanding legacy code instead of just rewriting it.
